Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file (to download, email or print), use this skill. However, if they ask for a document, page, report, memo, or notes WITHOUT naming a file format and the session offers Claude's own dedicated document or page skill or connector, use that instead. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or coding unrelated to document generation. (claude.ai sync)","argumentHint":"","aliases":["docx"]},{"name":"anthropic-skills:import-memory","description":"Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01AYv8TXCzDJhJZcw5nSAmmo","type":"tool_result","content":"178\t- `TagDaqSettings.scaleReadScript?: string` — okuma dönüşümü (value → scaled)\n179\t- `TagDaqSettings.scaleWriteScript?: string` — yazma dönüşümü (scaled → raw)\n180\t- Safe execution via vm module (reuse ScriptEngine pattern)\n181\t- Script parameter must be named `value`\n182\t- Preview: raw value → scaled value live preview\n183\t\n184\t### 3.3 Alarm runScript Action Implementation\n185\t\n186\t**Neden:** FUXA'da alarm tetiklendiğinde script çalıştırma var. Bizde stub olarak yazılmış.\n187\t\n188\t**Dosyalar:**\n189\t- `apps/sensor-service/src/scada-runtime/services/alarm-engine.service.ts` — GÜNCELLE\n190\t\n191\t**Özellikler:**\n192\t- `runScript` action type'ı gerçek ScriptEngineService.runScript() çağırsın\n193\t- Action params: scriptId, optional parameters\n194\t- Execution context: alarm instance bilgisi ($alarm object)\n195\t- Error handling: script failure alarm'ı clear etmemeli\n196\t\n197\t---\n198\t\n199\t## FAZ 4: Chart & Report Sistemi (ORTA)\n200\t\n201\t### 4.1 Bar/Pie Chart Widget Types\n202\t\n203\t**Neden:** FUXA'da Chart.js bar/pie var. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01478f56o2BZzohtCLVAyyrY","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * API Key Authentication Strategy\n3\t *\n4\t * Validates API key authentication using HMAC-SHA256 with timing-safe comparison.\n5\t * Supports legacy SHA-256 hashes during migration period.\n6\t *\n7\t * SECURITY (H-09): API key hashing upgraded from plain SHA-256 to HMAC-SHA256\n8\t * with a server-side secret (API_KEY_HMAC_SECRET). Timing-safe comparison is\n9\t * used for all hash lookups to prevent side-channel attacks. Legacy SHA-256\n10\t * is supported during the migration period.\n11\t */\n12\t\n13\timport * as crypto from 'crypto';\n14\t\n15\timport {\n16\t  Injectable,\n17\t  UnauthorizedException,\n18\t  Logger,\n19\t  Inject,\n20\t} from '@nestjs/common';\n21\timport { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';\n22\t\n23\timport { AuthenticatedRequest, ApiKeyInfo } from '../../types/index';\n24\t\n25\t/**\n26\t * API Key Authentication Strategy\n27\t * Handles validation of API key credentials from request headers\n28\t *\n29\t * NOTE: Explicit @Inject() decorators are required because Nx webpack (SWC loader)\n30\t * strips TypeScript emitDecoratorMetadata (design:paramtypes) during bundling.\n31\t * Without explicit @Inject(), NestJS cannot resolve constructor dependencies at runtime.\n32\t */\n33\t@Injectable()\n34\texport class ApiKeyAuthStrategy {\n35\t  private readonly logger = new Logger(ApiKeyAuthStrategy.name);\n36\t  private readonly apiKeys: Map<string, ApiKeyInfo>;\n37\t\n38\t  constructor(@Inject(ConfigService) private readonly configService: ConfigService) {\n39\t    this.apiKeys = new Map();\n40\t    this.loadApiKeys();\n41\t  }\n42\t\n43\t  /**\n44\t   * Validate API key from request\n45\t   *\n46\t   * SECURITY: API keys must only be accepted from headers, never from query parameters.\n47\t   * Query parameters are logged, cached, and visible in browser history.\n48\t   *\n49\t   * @param request - The incoming HTTP request\n50\t   * @returns true if the API key is valid and active\n51\t   * @throws {UnauthorizedException} If the API key is missing, invalid, disabled, or expired\n52\t   */\n53\t  validate(request: AuthenticatedRequest): boolean {\n54\t    // SECURITY: Only accept API key from x-api-key header\n55\t    // Never from query parameters (would be exposed in logs, URLs, referrer headers)\n56\t    const apiKey = request.headers['x-api-key'] as string;\n57\t\n58\t    if (!apiKey) {\n59\t      throw new UnauthorizedException({\n60\t        code: 'MISSING_API_KEY',\n61\t        message: 'API key is required. Use x-api-key header.',\n62\t      });\n63\t    }\n64\t\n65\t    const keyInfo = this.findApiKeyInfo(apiKey);\n66\t\n67\t    if (!keyInfo) {\n68\t      throw new UnauthorizedException({\n69\t        code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',\n70\t        message: 'Invalid API key',\n71\t      });\n72\t    }\n73\t\n74\t    if (!keyInfo.active) {\n75\t      throw new UnauthorizedException({\n76\t        code: 'API_KEY_DISABLED',\n77\t        message: 'API key is disabled',\n78\t      });\n79\t    }\n80\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8bfa4baf-81d9-41bd-b6b7-d4e3eaa7ed2f","uuid":"1c5d8a3c-12ff-43c6-9615-5ffc290c0c27","timestamp":"2026-09-19T16:00:31.203Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-af7637997ee1/apps/gateway-api/src/guards/strategies/api-key-auth.strategy.ts","content":"/**\n * API Key Authentication Strategy\n *\n * Validates API key authentication using HMAC-SHA256 with timing-safe comparison.\n * Supports legacy SHA-256 hashes during migration period.\n *\n * SECURITY (H-09): API key hashing upgraded from plain SHA-256 to HMAC-SHA256\n * with a server-side secret (API_KEY_HMAC_SECRET). Timing-safe comparison is\n * used for all hash lookups to prevent side-channel attacks. Legacy SHA-256\n * is supported during the migration period.\n */\n\nimport * as crypto from 'crypto';\n\nimport {\n  Injectable,\n  UnauthorizedException,\n  Logger,\n  Inject,\n} from '@nestjs/common';\nimport { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';\n\nimport { AuthenticatedRequest, ApiKeyInfo } from '../../types/index';\n\n/**\n * API Key Authentication Strategy\n * Handles validation of API key credentials from request headers\n *\n * NOTE: Explicit @Inject() decorators are required because Nx webpack (SWC loader)\n * strips TypeScript emitDecoratorMetadata (design:paramtypes) during bundling.\n * Without explicit @Inject(), NestJS cannot resolve constructor dependencies at runtime.\n */\n@Injectable()\nexport class ApiKeyAuthStrategy {\n  private readonly logger = new Logger(ApiKeyAuthStrategy.name);\n  private readonly apiKeys: Map<string, ApiKeyInfo>;\n\n  constructor(@Inject(ConfigService) private readonly configService: ConfigService) {\n    this.apiKeys = new Map();\n    this.loadApiKeys();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validate API key from request\n   *\n   * SECURITY: API keys must only be accepted from headers, never from query parameters.\n   * Query parameters are logged, cached, and visible in browser history.\n   *\n   * @param request - The incoming HTTP request\n   * @returns true if the API key is valid and active\n   * @throws {UnauthorizedException} If the API key is missing, invalid, disabled, or expired\n   */\n  validate(request: AuthenticatedRequest): boolean {\n    // SECURITY: Only accept API key from x-api-key header\n    // Never from query parameters (would be exposed in logs, URLs, referrer headers)\n    const apiKey = request.headers['x-api-key'] as string;\n\n    if (!apiKey) {\n      throw new UnauthorizedException({\n        code: 'MISSING_API_KEY',\n        message: 'API key is required. Use x-api-key header.',\n      });\n    }\n\n    const keyInfo = this.findApiKeyInfo(apiKey);\n\n    if (!keyInfo) {\n      throw new UnauthorizedException({\n        code: 'INVALID_API_KEY',\n        message: 'Invalid API key',\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (!keyInfo.active) {\n      throw new UnauthorizedException({\n        code: 'API_KEY_DISABLED',\n        message: 'API key is disabled',\n      });\n    }\n","numLines":80,"startLine":1,"totalLines":202}}}

Stale docs are worse\n6\t// than missing docs: they answer confidently and wrongly.\n7\t// WHAT (deterministic, fs-only): every backtick-quoted repo path in\n8\t// docs/**/*.md is resolved against the working tree; a reference to a path\n9\t// that no longer exists is a `doc_references_missing_path` finding with the\n10\t// doc's file:line as evidence. Globs, placeholders, and line-suffixed refs\n11\t// are handled so the rule stays low-noise.\n12\timport { relative } from 'node:path';\n13\t\n14\timport {\n15\t  collectFiles,\n16\t  filterFilesBySnapshot,\n17\t  normalizeWorkspacePath,\n18\t  readWorkspaceFile,\n19\t  requireScanRoots,\n20\t  resolveInsideWorkspace,\n21\t  workspacePathExists,\n22\t} from };\n27\t}\n28\t\n29\tinterface EvidenceRef {\n30\t  readonly path: string;\n31\t  readonly line?: number;\n32\t}\n33\t\n34\tinterface AdapterObservation {\n35\t  readonly id: string;\n36\t  readonly `feature/branch-name` or `owner/repo` never\n64\t// matches, which is what keeps this rule quiet.\n65\tconst PATH_PREFIXES = [\n66\t  'apps/',\n67\t  'e2e/',\n68\t  'infrastructure/',\n69\t  'libs/',\n70\t  'platform/',\n71\t  'scripts/',\n72\t  'sens-api-gateway/',\n73\t  'tools/',\n74\t  'web/',\n75\t];\n76\t\n77\tconst BACKTICK_SPAN_RE = /`([^`\\n]+)`/g;\n78\t\n79\tfunction candidateRef(span: string): string | undefined {\n80\t  let text = span.trim();\n81\t  // `path:123` / `path:12-40` — evidence-style refs pin a line, the claim\n82\t  // is about the path.\n83\t  text = text.replace(/:[0-9][0-9-]*$/, '');\n84\t  if (!PATH_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => text.startsWith(prefix))) {\n85\t    return undefined;\n86\t  }\n87\t  // Globs and placeholders are patterns, not path claims.\n88\t  if (/[*{}<>$\\s]/.test(text) || text.includes('...')) {\n89\t    return undefined;\n90\t  }\n91\t  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_@./-]+$/.test(text)) {\n92\t    return undefined;\n93\t  }\n94\t  return text.replace(/\\/$/, '');\n95\t}\n96\t\n97\texport function analyzeDocStaleness(\n98\t  input: AdapterInput,\n99\t  workspaceRoot = process.cwd(),\n100\t): AriaOutput {\n101\t  const roots = requireScanRoots('doc-staleness-adapter', input.roots);\n102\t  const observations: AdapterObservation[] = [];\n103\t  const findings: AdapterFinding[] = [];\n104\t  const readPaths: string[] = workspacePathExists(root))\n110\t      .flatMap((root) => collectFiles(root, { extensions: ['.md'] })),\n111\t    workspaceRoot,\n112\t    input,\n113\t  );\n114\t\n115\t  let refsChecked = 0;\n116\t  for (const doc of docs) {\n117\t    const docRel = normalizeWorkspacePath(relative(workspaceRoot, doc));\n118\t    readPaths.push(docRel);\n119\t    const lines = path: docRel,\n137\t          line: index + 1,\n138\t          message:\n139\t            `\\`${docRel}\\` references \\`${ref}\\`, which no longer exists — ` +\n140\t            'the doc answers confidently about a surface that is gone.',\n141\t          evidence: [{ path: docRel, line: index + 1 }],\n142\t          confidence: 0.85,\n143\t        });\n144\t      }\n145\t    }\n146\t    observations.push({\n147\t      id: `doc-staleness:doc:${docRel}`,\n148\t      type: 'doc_staleness_document',\n149\t      path: docRel,\n150\t      details: { missingRefs: missingInDoc },\n151\t    });\n152\t  }\n153\t\n154\t  const sortedReadPaths = [...new Set(readPaths)].sort();\n155\t  return {\n156\t    observations: observations.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),\n157\t    findings: findings.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),\n158\t    read_paths: sortedReadPaths,\n159\t    evidence_sources: sortedReadPaths,\n160\t    belief_candidates: [],\n161\t    cost_units: sortedReadPaths.length,\n162\t    metadata: { scanMode: 'doc_staleness_v1', docCount: docs.length, refsChecked },\n163\t  };\n164\t}\n165\t\n166\tfunction readStdin(): Promise<string> {\n167\t  return new Promise((resolvePromise, reject) => {\n168\t    let input = '';\n169\t    process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');\n170\t    // setEncoding('utf8') makes every chunk a string at runtime, but the\n171\t Narrow at the boundary rather\n173\t    // than widening `input` (kernel-dead-wire-adapter is the converged shape).\n174\t    process.stdin.on('data', (chunk: string | Buffer) => {\n175\t      input += typeof chunk === 'string' ? chunk : chunk.toString('utf8');\n176\t    });\n177\t    process.stdin.on('end', () => resolvePromise(input));\n178\t    process.stdin.on('error', reject);\n179\t  });\n180\t}\n181\t\n182\tasync function main(): Promise<void> {\n183\t  const rawInput = await readStdin();\n184\t  const input = rawInput.trim().length > 0 ? (JSON.parse(rawInput) as AdapterInput) : {};\n185\t  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(analyzeDocStaleness(input))}\\n`);\n186\t}\n187\t\n188\tif (require.main === module) {\n189\t  main().catch((error: unknown) => {\n190\t    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n191\t    process.stderr.write(`${message}\\n`);\n192\t    process.exit(1);\n193\t  });\n194\t}\n195\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8bfa4baf-81d9-41bd-b6b7-d4e3eaa7ed2f","uuid":"6e6c5943-2b76-4b8b-8a1e-095dd96040af","timestamp":"2026-09-19T16:01:39.892Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-af7637997ee1/tools/aria-adapters/doc-staleness-adapter.ts","content":"#!/usr/bin/env ts-node\n// D5-documentation dimension adapter v1 (Plan \"ARIA Sinir Sistemi\" FAZ 7).\n//\n// WHY: nothing watched documentation truth — a runbook can name a script\n// that was deleted a year ago and stay green forever. Stale docs are worse\n// than missing docs: they answer confidently and wrongly.\n// WHAT (deterministic, fs-only): every backtick-quoted repo path in\n// docs/**/*.md is resolved against the working tree; a reference to a path\n// that no longer exists is a `doc_references_missing_path` finding with the\n// doc's file:line as evidence. Globs, placeholders, and line-suffixed refs\n// are handled so the rule stays low-noise.\nimport { relative } from 'node:path';\n\nimport {\n  collectFiles,\n  filterFilesBySnapshot,\n  normalizeWorkspacePath,\n  readWorkspaceFile,\n  requireScanRoots,\n  resolveInsideWorkspace,\n  workspacePathExists,\n} from './adapter-fs';\n\ninterface AdapterInput {\n  readonly roots?: readonly string[];\n  readonly repo_snapshot?: { readonly allowed_paths?: readonly string[] };\n}\n\ninterface EvidenceRef {\n  readonly path: string;\n  readonly line?: number;\n}\n\ninterface AdapterObservation {\n  readonly id: string;\n  readonly type: string;\n  readonly path?: string;\n  readonly details?: Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\ninterface AdapterFinding {\n  readonly id: string;\n  readonly rule: 'doc_references_missing_path';\n  readonly severity: 'medium';\n  readonly path: string;\n  readonly line: number;\n  readonly message: string;\n  readonly evidence: readonly EvidenceRef[];\n  readonly confidence?: number;\n}\n\ninterface AriaOutput {\n  readonly observations: readonly AdapterObservation[];\n  readonly findings: readonly AdapterFinding[];\n  readonly read_paths: readonly string[];\n  readonly evidence_sources: readonly string[];\n  readonly belief_candidates: readonly unknown[];\n  readonly cost_units: number;\n  readonly metadata: Record<string, unknown>;\n}\n\n// A ref must start at a known top-level code directory to count as a repo\n// path claim — prose like `feature/branch-name` or `owner/repo` never\n// matches, which is what keeps this rule quiet.\nconst PATH_PREFIXES = [\n  'apps/',\n  'e2e/',\n  'infrastructure/',\n  'libs/',\n  'platform/',\n  'scripts/',\n  'sens-api-gateway/',\n  'tools/',\n  'web/',\n];\n\nconst BACKTICK_SPAN_RE = /`([^`\\n]+)`/g;\n\nfunction candidateRef(span: string): string | undefined {\n  let text = span.trim();\n  // `path:123` / `path:12-40` — evidence-style refs pin a line, the claim\n  // is about the path.\n  text = text.replace(/:[0-9][0-9-]*$/, '');\n  if (!PATH_PREFIXES.some((prefix) => text.startsWith(prefix))) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n  // Globs and placeholders are patterns, not path claims.\n  if (/[*{}<>$\\s]/.test(text) || text.includes('...')) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n  if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_@./-]+$/.test(text)) {\n    return undefined;\n  }\n  return text.replace(/\\/$/, '');\n}\n\nexport function analyzeDocStaleness(\n  input: AdapterInput,\n  workspaceRoot = process.cwd(),\n): AriaOutput {\n  const roots = requireScanRoots('doc-staleness-adapter', input.roots);\n  const observations: AdapterObservation[] = [];\n  const findings: AdapterFinding[] = [];\n  const readPaths: string[] = [];\n\n  const docs = filterFilesBySnapshot(\n    roots\n      .map((root) => resolveInsideWorkspace(workspaceRoot, root))\n      .filter((root) => workspacePathExists(root))\n      .flatMap((root) => collectFiles(root, { extensions: ['.md'] })),\n    workspaceRoot,\n    input,\n  );\n\n  let refsChecked = 0;\n  for (const doc of docs) {\n    const docRel = normalizeWorkspacePath(relative(workspaceRoot, doc));\n    readPaths.push(docRel);\n    const lines = readWorkspaceFile(doc).split('\\n');\n    let missingInDoc = 0;\n    for (let index = 0; index < lines.length; index += 1) {\n      for (const match of lines[index].matchAll(BACKTICK_SPAN_RE)) {\n        const ref = candidateRef(match[1]);\n        if (ref === undefined) {\n          continue;\n        }\n        refsChecked += 1;\n        if (workspacePathExists(resolveInsideWorkspace(workspaceRoot, ref))) {\n          continue;\n        }\n        missingInDoc += 1;\n        findings.push({\n          id: `doc-staleness:missing:${docRel}:${index + 1}:${ref}`,\n          rule: 'doc_references_missing_path',\n          severity: 'medium',\n          path: docRel,\n          line: index + 1,\n          message:\n            `\\`${docRel}\\` references \\`${ref}\\`, which no longer exists — ` +\n            'the doc answers confidently about a surface that is gone.',\n          evidence: [{ path: docRel, line: index + 1 }],\n          confidence: 0.85,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    observations.push({\n      id: `doc-staleness:doc:${docRel}`,\n      type: 'doc_staleness_document',\n      path: docRel,\n      details: { missingRefs: missingInDoc },\n    });\n  }\n\n  const sortedReadPaths = [...new Set(readPaths)].sort();\n  return {\n    observations: observations.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),\n    findings: findings.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id)),\n    read_paths: sortedReadPaths,\n    evidence_sources: sortedReadPaths,\n    belief_candidates: [],\n    cost_units: sortedReadPaths.length,\n    metadata: { scanMode: 'doc_staleness_v1', docCount: docs.length, refsChecked },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction readStdin(): Promise<string> {\n  return new Promise((resolvePromise, reject) => {\n    let input = '';\n    process.stdin.setEncoding('utf8');\n    // setEncoding('utf8') makes every chunk a string at runtime, but the\n    // stream's declared chunk type stays `string | Buffer` — concatenating the\n    // union is what the type checker rejects. Narrow at the boundary rather\n    // than widening `input` (kernel-dead-wire-adapter is the converged shape).\n    process.stdin.on('data', (chunk: string | Buffer) => {\n      input += typeof chunk === 'string' ? chunk : chunk.toString('utf8');\n    });\n    process.stdin.on('end', () => resolvePromise(input));\n    process.stdin.on('error', reject);\n  });\n}\n\nasync function main(): Promise<void> {\n  const rawInput = await readStdin();\n  const input = rawInput.trim().length > 0 ? (JSON.parse(rawInput) as AdapterInput) : {};\n  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(analyzeDocStaleness(input))}\\n`);\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n  main().catch((error: unknown) => {\n    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n    process.stderr.write(`${message}\\n`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  });\n}\n","numLines":195,"startLine":1,"totalLines":195}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01SbKDShfQgDcUPh7QLb8cAh","type":"tool_result","content":"2225\t            contract = \"tools/aria-poc/ci_executor_contract_proven.md\"\n2226\t            raise ClaudeCliUnavailable(f\"{exc}; see {contract}\") from exc\n2227\t        raise\n2228\t    # Plan ARIA-V7 §2g v2 + V7.10 envelope-extraction fix.\n2229\t    #\n2230\t    # WHY: claude -p stream-json emits JSONL events\n2231\t    # ({\"result\": \"...\", \"total_cost_usd\": ..., ...}) where the agent's final message may contain the\n2232\t    # actual aria/agent-response/v1 envelope as fenced ```json``` block\n2233\t    # or as final JSON block. Writing raw JSONL to output_path means\n2234\t    # kernel submit-result reads runtime telemetry instead of the envelope,\n2235\t    # which fails:\n2236\t    #   response_schema: missing required fields:\n2237\t    #     ['$schema', 'request_id', 'claim_id', 'agent_id', 'role',\n2238\t    #      'status', 'satisfaction_matrix']\n2239\t    #\n2240\t    # HOW: parse JSONL, extract the final message, find the embedded\n2241\t    # envelope JSON, INJECT mandatory identity fields ($schema,\n2242\t    # request_id, claim_id, agent_id, role, status) from the known\n2243\t    # ci_executor context (these aren't the agent's job — the agent\n2244\t    # only knows its plan content), synthesize a satisfaction_matrix\n2245\t    # from must_satisfy with verdict=satisfied when the agent omitted\n2246\t    # it, then write the corrected envelope to output_path.\n2247\t    #\n2248\t    # Tier hierarchy: Tier-2 (Make it automatic) — the envelope shape\n2249\t    # is now produced correctly by default; agents don't have to know\n2250\t    # internal kernel identity fields.\n2251\t    if completed.stdout:\n2252\t        envelope = _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n2253\t            raw_stdout=completed.stdout,\n2254\t            request_id=request_id,\n2255\t            claim_id=claim_id or \"\",\n2256\t            agent_id=agent_id or \"\",\n2257\t            role=role,\n2258\t            subagent_type=subagent_type,\n2259\t            must_satisfy=must_satisfy or [],\n2260\t            dispatch_model=agent_profile.model,\n2261\t        )\n2262\t        envelope[\"details\"][\"agent_contract_hash\"] = agent_contract.contract_hash\n2263\t        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n2264\t        _write_sanitized_envelope(output_path, envelope)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8bfa4baf-81d9-41bd-b6b7-d4e3eaa7ed2f","uuid":"c7ce88f8-ed4d-432d-b38e-339bb4f94323","timestamp":"2026-09-19T16:03:34.722Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-evidence-judge-af7637997ee1/tools/aria-poc/ci_executor.py","content":"            contract = \"tools/aria-poc/ci_executor_contract_proven.md\"\n            raise ClaudeCliUnavailable(f\"{exc}; see {contract}\") from exc\n        raise\n    # Plan ARIA-V7 §2g v2 + V7.10 envelope-extraction fix.\n    #\n    # WHY: claude -p stream-json emits JSONL events\n    # ({\"result\": \"...\", \"total_cost_usd\": ..., ...}) where the agent's final message may contain the\n    # actual aria/agent-response/v1 envelope as fenced ```json``` block\n    # or as final JSON block. Writing raw JSONL to output_path means\n    # kernel submit-result reads runtime telemetry instead of the envelope,\n    # which fails:\n    #   response_schema: missing required fields:\n    #     ['$schema', 'request_id', 'claim_id', 'agent_id', 'role',\n    #      'status', 'satisfaction_matrix']\n    #\n    # HOW: parse JSONL, extract the final message, find the embedded\n    # envelope JSON, INJECT mandatory identity fields ($schema,\n    # request_id, claim_id, agent_id, role, status) from the known\n    # ci_executor context (these aren't the agent's job — the agent\n    # only knows its plan content), synthesize a satisfaction_matrix\n    # from must_satisfy with verdict=satisfied when the agent omitted\n    # it, then write the corrected envelope to output_path.\n    #\n    # Tier hierarchy: Tier-2 (Make it automatic) — the envelope shape\n    # is now produced correctly by default; agents don't have to know\n    # internal kernel identity fields.\n    if completed.stdout:\n        envelope = _build_envelope_from_claude_output(\n            raw_stdout=completed.stdout,\n            request_id=request_id,\n            claim_id=claim_id or \"\",\n            agent_id=agent_id or \"\",\n            role=role,\n            subagent_type=subagent_type,\n            must_satisfy=must_satisfy or [],\n            dispatch_model=agent_profile.model,\n        )\n        envelope[\"details\"][\"agent_contract_hash\"] = agent_contract.contract_hash\n        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        _write_sanitized_envelope(output_path, envelope)","numLines":40,"startLine":2225,"totalLines":5265}}}

Uncertainty is a VALID arbitration\n        # outcome, for the arbiter alone, with a reason from the closed\n        # vocabulary; binary judges stay bound to binary verdicts.\n        reason = verdict_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if (\n            role == \"consensus_arbitration\"\n            and verdict is None\n            and reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS\n        ):\n            pass\n        else:\n            errors.append(f\"judge_verdict.verdict:invalid:{verdict!r}\")\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_tool_run_or_finding_id\")\n    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n    if not judge_id:\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:missing_judge_identity\")\n    elif str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n        errors.append(\"judge_verdict:executor_shaped_judge_identity\")\n    return errors\n\n\ndef record_judge_verdict_from_response(\n    *,\n    request: dict[str, Any],\n    response: dict[str, Any],\n    base_dir: str | Path | None = None,\n) -> dict[str, Any] | None:\n    \"\"\"Translate an ACCEPTED judge response into an ai_judge feedback row.\n\n    Returns the persisted row, or None when the envelope role is not a\n    judge role (the bridge is a no-op for non-judge submissions).\n\n    Raises GovernanceError when the response is missing the data the\n    consensus engine requires (tool_id / run_id / finding_id come from\n    the request envelope's optional fields; verdict + severity from\n    the response.details).\n    \"\"\"\n    role = response.get(\"role\")\n    if not is_judge_role(role):\n        return None\n\n    # Y5 (ORPHAN-706) — one contract, two consumers: the executor's\n    # pre-submit gate checks exactly this list and releases instead of\n    # sealing an unfoldable accepted result; the bridge raises on it so a\n    # row that somehow slipped past still fails loudly, never half-folds.\n    contract_errors = validate_judge_response(request=request, response=response)\n    if contract_errors:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge contract violation: \" + \"; \".join(contract_errors)\n        )\n\n    details = response.get(\"details\") or {}\n    if not isinstance(details, dict):\n        details = {}\n\n    # ORPHAN-CRITICAL-735 — the arbiter's legitimate non-verdict outcome\n    # folds through the SAME producer, ledger and idempotent escalation_id\n    # as the deterministic engine, so one sweep drains both lanes into one\n    # HUMAN_REQUIRED record. It is NOT a feedback verdict: an uncertain\n    # arbitration must never write an ai_judge row.\n    if role == \"consensus_arbitration\":\n        arb_block = _verdict_field(details)\n        arb_reason = arb_block.get(\"uncertainty_reason\")\n        if arb_block.get(\"verdict\") is None and arb_reason in CONSENSUS_UNCERTAINTY_REASONS:\n            from .feedback_store import record_consensus_uncertainty\n\n            row = record_consensus_uncertainty(\n                tool_id=str(request.get(\"tool_id\") or arb_block.get(\"tool_id\") or \"\"),\n                run_id=str(request.get(\"run_id\") or arb_block.get(\"run_id\") or \"\"),\n                finding_id=str(request.get(\"finding_id\") or arb_block.get(\"finding_id\") or \"\"),\n                group_id=str(request.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or arb_block.get(\"group_id\") or \"\"),\n                reason=str(arb_reason),\n                cycle_id=request.get(\"cycle_id\"),\n                base_dir=base_dir,\n            )\n            return {\"kind\": \"consensus_uncertainty\", **row}\n    verdict_block = _verdict_field(details)\n\n    tool_id = request.get(\"tool_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"tool_id\")\n    run_id = request.get(\"run_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"run_id\")\n    finding_id = request.get(\"finding_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_id\")\n    if not (tool_id and run_id and finding_id):\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge requires tool_id, run_id, finding_id in request or response.details.verdict; \"\n            f\"got tool_id={tool_id!r}, run_id={run_id!r}, finding_id={finding_id!r}\"\n        )\n\n    verdict = verdict_block.get(\"verdict\")\n    if verdict not in FEEDBACK_VERDICTS:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            f\"judge bridge expected verdict in {FEEDBACK_VERDICTS}, got {verdict!r}\"\n        )\n    severity = _coerce_severity(verdict_block.get(\"severity\") or details.get(\"severity\"))\n    # D1 (Kapalı Döngü) — judge identity. `response[\"agent_id\"]` is the\n    # EXECUTOR's identity (`ci-executor:gha-<run>`), not the judge's: reading\n    # it collapsed every judge drained by one workflow run into a single\n    # voter (consensus structurally impossible) while judges drained by\n    # DIFFERENT runs counted as distinct voters with meaningless identity.\n    # The judge's real identity is the subagent the executor invoked\n    # (`details.agent_subagent_type`, force-stamped by ci_executor); the\n    # mock lane and legacy envelopes carry it as `verdict.judge_id`.\n    judge_id = details.get(\"agent_subagent_type\") or verdict_block.get(\"judge_id\")\n    if not judge_id:\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            \"judge bridge requires details.agent_subagent_type \"\n            \"(or details.verdict.judge_id)\"\n        )\n    if str(judge_id).startswith(\"ci-executor:\"):\n        # Refuse loudly instead of silently repairing: an executor-shaped\n        # identity means the producer regressed, and a repaired row would\n        # hide that while still poisoning per-judge calibration.\n        raise GovernanceError(\n            f\"judge bridge refuses executor-shaped judge identity: {judge_id!r}\"\n        )\n\n    # The unit-interval gate, not a bare isinstance: True is an int and\n    # float(\"nan\") is a float to isinstance, and both would ride a judge\n    # verdict into calibration as if they were probabilities.\n    confidence = confidence_in_unit_interval(verdict_block.get(\"confidence\"))\n\n    note = (\n        verdict_block.get(\"rationale\")\n        or verdict_block.get(\"note\")\n        or response.get(\"rationale\")\n        or \"envelope-routed judge submission\"\n    )\n    if not isinstance(note, str) or not note.strip():\n        note = \"envelope-routed judge submission\"\n\n    raw_evidence_refs = verdict_block.get(\"evidence_refs\") or response.get(\"evidence_refs\") or []\n    evidence_refs = [str(r) for r in raw_evidence_refs if isinstance(r, str) and r.strip()]\n\n    row = record_operator_feedback(\n        tool_id=str(tool_id),\n        run_id=str(run_id),\n        finding_id=str(finding_id),\n        verdict=verdict,\n        severity=severity,\n        note=note,\n        source_type=\"ai_judge\",\n        judge_id=str(judge_id),\n        # ORPHAN-HIGH-781 — mint-first doctrine, same as judgment_group_id\n        # and finding_fingerprint above: the model the DISPATCHER resolved\n        # (`details.agent_dispatch_model`, force-stamped by ci_executor from\n        # the runtime profile) outranks the judge's own verdict.model\n        # self-report. The anchor distinct-model count must not trust a\n        # string the judged agent wrote about itself; the self-report\n        # survives only as the fallback for mock/legacy envelopes that\n        # predate the stamp.\n        model=details.get(\"agent_dispatch_model\") or verdict_block.get(\"model\"),\n        prompt_hash=verdict_block.get(\"prompt_hash\"),\n        confidence=float(confidence) if confidence is not None else None,\n        rationale=str(note),\n        evidence_refs=evidence_refs,\n        # D1 — group identity comes from the MINT (judge_fanout's canonical\n        # `judge:<tool>:<run>:<finding>`), never from the judge's own payload:\n        # a judge echoing its request id as group id split one finding's two\n        # verdicts across two groups-of-one, so the real disagreement on\n        # anthropic.provider.ts:3 never met itself and never escalated.\n        judgment_group_id=request.get(\"judgment_group_id\") or verdict_block.get(\"judgment_group_id\"),\n        # ORPHAN-HIGH-765 — the fingerprint follows the SAME D1 doctrine as\n        # the group id above: mint first, envelope only as fallback. On live\n        # state 7 of 8 ai_judge rows carried an empty fingerprint because\n        # the mint never carried it and no prompt asks the judge to echo it,\n        # so every consensus row settled from those rows inherited the empty\n        # key — and promote_consensus_findings silently skipped it forever.\n        finding_fingerprint=request.get(\"finding_fingerprint\") or verdict_block.get(\"finding_fingerprint\"),\n        base_dir=base_dir,\n    )\n    return row","numLines":240,"startLine":60,"totalLines":388}}}

Post-fix the resolution runs first, then SELF_OUTPUT is\n509\t    # decided on the canonical posix-relative form.\n510\t    from .tool_registry import GovernanceError as _GE\n511\t    try:\n512\t        rel_str, absolute = _canonical_evidence_path(path, root)\n513\t    except _GE as exc:\n514\t        msg = str(exc)\n515\t        if msg.startswith(\"evidence_path_outside_repo\"):\n516\t            errors.append({\"code\": \"agent_evidence_path_escapes_workspace\", \"path\": path})\n517\t        else:\n518\t            errors.append({\"code\": \"agent_evidence_path_unresolvable\", \"path\": path,\n519\t                           \"error\": msg})\n520\t        return\n521\t    #
